rules.requirement: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.

assertingTests.name: poison lasts the night and the next day, then expires (TB-POISONER-01)
a Poisoner who becomes the Imp ends the poison it sourced (TB-POISONER-01)
a healthy Poisoner's choice records one dated poison, its note and one secret log line (TB-POISONER-01)
a new Poisoner choice ends the poison it sourced before and leaves another source's poison (TB-POISONER-01)
an impaired Poisoner's choice poisons no one and records the shared failure note (TB-POISONER-01)
a healthy Poisoner returns one poison for tonight and tomorrow day (TB-POISONER-01)
an impaired Poisoner reports a suppressed ability (TB-POISONER-01)
